safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a history of anxiety and currently feels panicked.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes a history of anxiety/panic attacks but does not document that the patient currently feels panicked.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that the patient currently feels panicked can impair interpretation of shortness of breath (panic-related vs evolving allergic reaction) and may affect triage/monitoring decisions in an acute setting. While the visit still addresses anaphylaxis red flags, the missing context could contribute to suboptimal risk assessment.
